basic_details.job_title: Visakhapatnam Port Authority Senior Deputy Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Visakhapatnam Port Authority General Administration Department (Personnel Division) has invited applications for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary (Class - I) on the scale of Rs. 80000 - 220000 by absorption through composite method of recruitment. Eligible and willing officers of all Major Port Authorities can submit applications through the 'Online Application Portal' (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) from 22.10.2026 to 21.11.2026, and send print-outs through proper channel along with required documents superscribing "Application for

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Desirable Senior Deputy Secretary (Class - I) (i) Bachelor's degree from a recognised University; and (ii) twelve years' experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration or Personnel or Industrial Relations, etc., in an Industrial or Commercial or Government Undertaking. Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management or Industrial Relations or Social Work or Labour Welfare or allied subjects or Degree in Law from a recognised University or institute. | For absorption through composite method, officers holding analogous posts or the post of Deputy Secretary and equivalent posts in the respective disciplines of General Administration Department (such as CPRO/Deputy Estate Manager/Deputy Chief Law Officer/Personnel Officer) in the scale of pay of Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) with three years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority or Deputy Secretary and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of General Administration Department with two years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of seven years in the scales of pay of Rs. 50000 - 160000 (Pre-revised Rs. 10750 - 16750) and Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in a Major Port Authority will be eligible. For deputation, officers holding analogous posts or post of Deputy Secretary and the equivalent post in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) in Government / Semi Government / Public Sector undertakings or autonomous bodies with three years regular service in the grade will be eligible.

selection_process: The selection is by merit for which the benchmark in overall grading in the ACR/APAR will not be below Very Good.
how_to_apply: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in.
Submit the online application between 22.10.2026 and 21.11.2026.
Take a print-out of the online application.

Attach copies of educational qualifications and experience, a self-attested passport size photograph, an undertaking that candidature will not be withdrawn (Annexure - IV), Administrative Clearance (Annexure - II), No Objection Certificate (Annexure - V), Vigilance/Administrative clearance proforma (Annexure - III), service particulars statement (Annexure - VI), and ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2021-2022 to 2025-2026) along with grading statement, duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy HoD on each page (or non-availability certificate).
Super-scribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Sr. Deputy Secretary (Class - I) in Visakhapatnam Port Authority".
Send the application through proper channel so as to reach the SECRETARY, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Port Area, Visakhapatnam - 530035 on or before 07.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: About VPA Senior Deputy Secretary Recruitment
content_sections.text: Visakhapatnam Port Authority is operating under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. The administration has issued a re-circulation notification to fill one vacant post of Senior Deputy Secretary in the General Administration Department. The selection is conducted by merit through composite method from eligible officers of Major Port Authorities.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 post available for recruitment under the General Administration Department of Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For absorption through composite method, officers holding analogous posts or the post of Deputy Secretary and equivalent posts in the respective disciplines of General Administration Department (such as CPRO/Deputy Estate Manager/Deputy Chief Law Officer/Personnel Officer) in the scale of pay of Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) with three years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority or Deputy Secretary and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of General Administration Department with two years regular service in the grade and a combined regular service of seven years in the scales of pay of Rs. 50000 - 160000 (Pre-revised Rs. 10750 - 16750) and Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in a Major Port Authority will be eligible. For deputation, officers holding analogous posts or post of Deputy Secretary and the equivalent post in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 60000 - 180000 (Pre-revised Rs. 13000 - 18250) in Government / Semi Government / Public Sector undertakings or autonomous bodies with three years regular service in the grade will be eligible.

rows.essential_qualification: (i) Bachelor's degree from a recognised University; and (ii) twelve years' experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration or Personnel or Industrial Relations, etc., in an Industrial or Commercial or Government Undertaking.
rows.desirable: Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Personnel Management or Industrial Relations or Social Work or Labour Welfare or allied subjects or Degree in Law from a recognised University or institute.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected officer will be appointed to the post of Sr. Dy. Secretary (Class - I) on scale Rs. 80000-220000 in the General Administration Department of Visakhapatnam Port Authority on Composite Method and will be governed by the Service Rules and Regulations in force as amended from time to time and terms & conditions prescribed by the Central Government.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VPA Senior Deputy Secretary
content_sections.text: Access the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways at http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in. Submit the online application between 22.10.2026 and 21.11.2026. Take a print-out of the online application. Attach copies of educational qualifications and experience, a self-attested passport size photograph, an undertaking that candidature will not be withdrawn (Annexure - IV), Administrative Clearance (Annexure - II), No Objection Certificate (Annexure - V), Vigilance/Administrative clearance proforma (Annexure - III), service particulars statement (Annexure - VI), and ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2021-2022 to 2025-2026) along with grading statement, duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Deputy HoD on each page (or non-availability certificate). Super-scribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Sr. Deputy Secretary (Class - I) in Visakhapatnam Port Authority". Send the application through proper channel so as to reach the SECRETARY, Visakhapatnam Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Port Area, Visakhapatnam - 530035 on or before 07.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is by merit for which the benchmark in overall grading in the ACR/APAR will not be below Very Good.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position announced by VPA?
faq.answer: Visakhapatnam Port Authority has announced recruitment for 1 post of Senior Deputy Secretary (Class - I) in the General Administration Department.

faq.question: Q2. What is the scale of pay for VPA Senior Deputy Secretary?
faq.answer: The post carries a scale of pay of Rs. 80,000 - 2,20,000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the start and end dates for submitting online applications?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 22.10.2026 to 21.11.2026 via the Ministry's Online Application Portal.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: The printed application sent through proper channel must reach the Secretary of Visakhapatnam Port Authority on or before 07.12.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for direct recruitment to this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for direct recruitment is 42 years.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for VPA Senior Deputy Secretary?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Bachelor's degree from a recognised University and twelve years' experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration or Personnel or Industrial Relations, etc., in an Industrial or Commercial or Government Undertaking.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection made for this post?
faq.answer: The selection is made by merit for which the overall grading in ACR/APAR must not be below Very Good.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if a candidate withdraws their candidature after selection?
faq.answer: A port official who withdraws candidature after selection by the Service Selection Committee will be liable for debarment from future selection to Dy. HoD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for two years.
